tool.name: TradeZella
tool.description: TradeZella is a trading journal that can import trades from brokers and prop firms. Plans differ by how many accounts you can connect, and by whether replay and the extra review tools are included.
features: Automated trade import from brokers and prop firms
Manual backtesting on stocks, futures, crypto and CFDs
Trade replay on the Pro and Ultra plans

plans.name: Essential
plans.detail: Or $26/mo when billed at $315 per year. One connected account.

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: Or $44/mo when billed at $531 per year. Up to 50 accounts, plus replay.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.detail: Or $74/mo when billed at $891 per year. Unlimited accounts, plus replay.

tool.pricing_note: Monthly and yearly prices from the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026.
